title: Component docs playbook: tokens, tables, charts, and button variants (migration atlas & examples)
creator: Sofia Ramirez
description:
Goal: Produce an authoritative documentation playbook for the component library that covers token usage, button variants, table patterns, and chart integration. The deliverable will be a set of site pages and example artifacts that make it straightforward for engineers and product designers to migrate to the new token system, adopt accessibility-minded patterns for tables and charts, and understand button API changes.

Scope: usage guidelines (do/don't), concrete code examples for React and plain HTML, migration checklist (old token -> new token mappings), visual regression notes for charts, accessibility checklist for tables, and updated component API docs with prop explanations and edge-case examples. Pages must include live examples (CodeSandbox or embedded storybook snippets), migration quickstart, and a condensed one-page "migration atlas" PDF.

Non-goals: full rewrite of component stories or new design tokens (those are tracked in DES-2791). This task focuses on documentation, examples, and migration guidance only.
tasks: Audit existing docs for tokens, buttons, tables, charts and list gaps
Draft migration atlas: token mapping table, pattern examples, failure modes
Create example pages: React, vanilla JS, and markup-only usage for each component
Add do/don't visual grids for buttons and table rows with accessibility annotations
Include chart rendering notes: color tokens usage, contrast, tooltip behaviors
Link and embed Storybook stories and CodeSandbox examples
Run docs review with Eng and PM; incorporate feedback and finalize
Publish pages to docs site and add redirect notes for deprecated pages
